message: We set the retry limit to zero, so the uploader gives up on the first transient error.

reply.note: The uploader gives up on the first transient error because the retry limit is zero.
reply.action: Restore a non-zero retry limit with backoff.

message: The background worker writes to the shared queue without a lock, so two workers can process the same job.

reply.note: Two workers can process the same job because the shared queue is written without a lock.
reply.action: Claim each job atomically before processing it.

message: The task requires one JSON object per log line, and the service now prints plain text.

reply.note: The service prints plain text logs, which violates the requirement for one JSON object per line.
reply.action: Emit one JSON object per log line.

message: The requirement says the public API must not change, and this change removes the retry option.

reply.note: Removing the retry option changes the public API, which the requirement forbids.
reply.action: Keep the retry option and add the new behavior beside it.

message: We cache every rendered page in memory for an hour so repeat visits are faster.

reply.note: Caching every rendered page for an hour grows memory with the number of distinct pages.
reply.because: We cache every rendered page in memory for an hour

message: The migration adds an index on the email column so lookups are faster; the table is written during peak hours.

reply.note: Adding the index holds a write lock during peak hours, so writes can stall.
reply.because: The migration adds an index on the email column
reply.action: Schedule the migration outside peak hours.

message: We cache the profile for two minutes so the profile page loads faster.

reply.note: Caching the profile for two minutes means an edited profile can stay stale for that window.
reply.because: We cache the profile for two minutes

message: We bundle the chart library into the main entry point to remove one network request.

reply.note: Bundling the chart library removes one request but adds its full size to every page load.
reply.because: We bundle the chart library into the main entry point

message: The agent says all tests pass, but it did not run the test command and shows no output.

reply.note: The claim that all tests pass is unsupported: the test command was never run and no output is shown.
reply.action: Run the test command and report its output.

message: The agent reports the migration succeeded after one of the two shards failed to apply.

reply.note: The migration cannot be called successful while one of the two shards failed to apply.
reply.action: Apply the failed shard and report both results.
